title.narrative: Strengthening Community Systems in displacement Affected Neighbourhoods

description.narrative: The project aims to enhance the self-reliance and well-being of vulnerable refugees, migrants, and host communities in marginalized areas of Greater Cairo by improving equitable access to protection mechanisms, basic and social services, and adequate housing. Overall objective: Vulnerable displaced and host communities in marginalised areas achieve greater self-reliance and well-being through equitable access to protection, as well as basic and social services. Using a gender-sensitive approach, the project addresses the specific protection risks and service barriers faced by women and girls, who make up around 60% of direct beneficiaries, including survivors of conflict and SGBV. This is achieved through access to legal aid, MHPSS, and essential services delivered via inclusive community hubs, while strengthening women-led and refugee-led organizations and ensuring safe spaces and effective referral pathways.
